verdict.rationale: Datadog's Bits AI product page (datadog-docs-4) is positioned as an AI assistant for observability, and Incident Management docs (datadog-docs-14) cover incident workflows, suggesting AI-generated incident summaries/alert context exist, but the evidence pack gives no detail on the summarization feature itself, no independent/hands-on confirmation, and no specifics on alert-context generation. missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of Bits AI's incident-summary/alert-context feature, independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as claimed.
